packageRules.description: The shared preset stays at the floating #v1 tag (README of ryanjdillon/workflows): no PR that pins it to a release.
Every automerge: Renovate merges the PR itself, by rebase, when every check passes. platformAutomerge is off, so a merge does not depend on branch protection.
The ryanjdillon/workflows pins (grouped by the shared preset): automerge on green checks. A major release waits for the owner.
